scopeNotes: Expands the staged introductory draft; the earlier review hash does not certify these new paragraphs.
1795 formation, 1810 completed unification, 1893 overthrow and 1898 annexation resolution are distinct events.
Only specific checked passages are used from broad institutional histories; their compressed or outdated statements elsewhere are not adopted.
entities.geometryStatus: Imported 1815 to 1914 snapshots are not revised or certified. Historical dates prevent post-1893 monarchy display, but no new pre-1815 geometry or provisional-government identity is created.
